# core-kernel

> Zero-dependency TypeScript building blocks for DDD / Clean Architecture on Bun and Node ≥ 20 (ESM + CJS, TypeScript ≥ 5.4). Business rules return `Result<T, E>` with typed errors instead of throwing.

Rules an assistant must follow when writing code with core-kernel:

- Never throw for expected failures. Return `Result.fail(new XxxError(...))`. `throw` is only for API misuse or bugs.
- Read `result.value` / `result.error` only after narrowing: `if (r.isFail()) return r;` then `r.value`. `if (!r.ok)` also narrows.
- A `Fail<E>` can be returned as any `Result<U, E'>` when `E` is part of `E'`, so propagate failures with `return r`.
- Entities and value objects have a `private constructor` and a `static create(...)` returning `Result`. Entities also have `static restore(props, id)` for rehydration (no validation, no events).
- State changes only through domain methods that return `Result<void, ...>`. No setters, no public `props`.
- Repositories return `T | null` and throw on infrastructure failure. Use cases turn `null` into `NotFoundError`. Extend `BaseUseCase` so thrown errors become `UnexpectedError`.
- Repositories hold writes + `findById` only. Screen/list reads go through query ports that return DTOs.
- Inject `Clock` instead of calling `new Date()` in use cases. Pass `now` into domain methods.
- Depend on the narrowest port: `FindByIdRepository<Order> & UpdateRepository<Order>`, not a full CRUD interface.
- Use typed ids: `class OrderId extends UniqueId { declare private readonly __brand: "OrderId" }`.
- Libraries built on core-kernel list it as a `peerDependency`.

## Imports

- `core-kernel`: Result, Ok, Fail, AppError, ValidationError, NotFoundError, ConflictError, ForbiddenError, UnexpectedError, isAppError, Guard, ValueObject, isValueObject, Entity, isEntity, AggregateRoot, UniqueId, IdGenerator, DomainEvent, createDomainEvent, Auditable, UseCase, BaseUseCase, CreateRepository, UpdateRepository, DeleteRepository, FindByIdRepository, CrudRepository, EntityId, Clock, systemClock, DomainEventPublisher, Mapper, PaginatedInputDTO, PaginationMetaDTO, PaginatedResultDTO, validatePagination, toPaginatedResult
- `core-kernel/vo`: Email, Text, Url, Money, DateRange, StrongPassword
- `core-kernel/vo/br`: Cpf, Cnpj (numeric and alphanumeric, IN RFB 2.229/2024)
- `core-kernel/testing`: InMemoryRepository, FixedClock, SequentialIdGenerator, InMemoryEventPublisher, assertOk, assertFail

## Result

```ts
type Result<T, E extends AppError = AppError> = Ok<T, E> | Fail<E>;
Result.ok(value) / Result.ok()                     // Result<T, never> / Result<void, never>
Result.fail(error)                                 // Result<never, E>
r.isOk() / r.isFail() / r.ok                       // narrowing
r.map(fn) / r.flatMap(fn) / r.mapError(fn) / r.match({ ok, fail }) / r.unwrapOr(x)
r.unwrap()                                         // throws the error: tests and app edges only
Result.combine([a, b] as const)                    // Result<[A, B], EA | EB>; merges ValidationError issues
Result.try(fn, mapError?) / Result.tryAsync(fn, mapError?)  // thrown → UnexpectedError (cause kept)
```

## Errors

```ts
new NotFoundError("Order not found", { code: "ORDER_NOT_FOUND", details?, cause? })
new ValidationError({ field: "email", code: "INVALID_EMAIL", message: "..." })   // or an array of issues
error.kind  // "validation" | "not_found" | "conflict" | "forbidden" | "unexpected" → adapters map to HTTP etc.
error.code  // stable machine-readable code; error.toJSON() for responses/logs
```

## Guard

All return `Result<void, ValidationError>` and accept `{ field?, code?, message? }`:
`required`, `notEmpty`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `inRange(value, { min?, max? })`, `integer`, `matches(value, regex)`, `oneOf(value, list)`.
`Guard.all([...])` accumulates every issue; `a.flatMap(() => b)` stops at the first failure.

## Value object template

```ts
export class Sku extends ValueObject<string> {
  private constructor(value: string) {
    super(value);
  }

  static create(raw: string, field = "sku"): Result<Sku, ValidationError> {
    const value = raw.trim().toUpperCase();
    return Guard.notEmpty(value, { field })
      .flatMap(() => Guard.matches(value, /^[A-Z0-9-]+$/, { field, code: "INVALID_SKU" }))
      .map(() => new Sku(value));
  }
}
```

`value` is deep-frozen; `equals` compares structure (same class only); `toJSON()` returns `value`.

## Aggregate template

```ts
type OrderConfirmed = DomainEvent<"order.confirmed", { confirmedAt: string }>;

export class Order extends AggregateRoot<OrderProps, OrderId, OrderConfirmed> {
  private constructor(props: OrderProps, id: OrderId) {
    super(props, id);
  }

  static create(input: CreateOrderInput): Result<Order, ValidationError> {
    // validate with Guard / VOs, then:
    // const order = new Order(props, OrderId.generate()); order.addDomainEvent(...); return Result.ok(order);
  }

  static restore(props: OrderProps, id: OrderId): Order {
    return new Order(props, id);
  }

  confirm(now: Date): Result<void, ConflictError> {
    if (this.props.status !== "pending") {
      return Result.fail(new ConflictError("Order is not pending", { code: "ORDER_NOT_PENDING" }));
    }
    this.props.status = "confirmed";
    this.addDomainEvent(createDomainEvent({ name: "order.confirmed", aggregateId: this.id.value, occurredAt: now, payload: { confirmedAt: now.toISOString() } }));
    return Result.ok();
  }
}
```

Entities are equal when they share class and id. `pullDomainEvents()` returns and clears pending events.

## Use case template

```ts
export class ConfirmOrderUseCase extends BaseUseCase<{ orderId: string }, void, ValidationError | NotFoundError | ConflictError> {
  constructor(
    private readonly orders: FindByIdRepository<Order> & UpdateRepository<Order>,
    private readonly events: DomainEventPublisher,
    private readonly clock: Clock,
  ) {
    super();
  }

  protected async handle({ orderId }: { orderId: string }) {
    const id = OrderId.from(orderId);
    if (id.isFail()) return id;
    const order = await this.orders.findById(id.value);
    if (!order) return Result.fail(new NotFoundError("Order not found", { code: "ORDER_NOT_FOUND" }));
    const confirmed = order.confirm(this.clock.now());
    if (confirmed.isFail()) return confirmed;
    await this.orders.update(order);
    await this.events.publish(order.pullDomainEvents());
    return Result.ok();
  }
}
// execute(input): Promise<Result<void, ValidationError | NotFoundError | ConflictError | UnexpectedError>>
```

## Testing

```ts
const orders = new InMemoryRepository<Order>([order]);   // extend it to add custom queries with this.find / this.filter
orders.failNext(new Error("db down"));                    // next call throws → UnexpectedError in BaseUseCase
const restoreIds = new SequentialIdGenerator("order").install(); // ids: order-1, order-2... (event ids share the sequence)
assertOk(result);              // narrows to Ok
assertFail(result, "CODE");    // narrows to Fail; CODE matches error.code or any validation issue code
```
